import json, pathlib
s=json.load(open('/inputs/selection.json')); r=s['targets'][0]; t=json.load(open('/inputs/tool-catalog.json')); op=next(x for x in t['tools'] if x['id']=='runtime.move'); assert op['runtimeOnly'] and op['runtimeApply']=='Live' and 'Instance' in op['scopes'] and {x['name'] for x in op['args'] if x['required']}=={'position','yaw'}
intent='Move only the selected live Bram instance in the running GameCore world, not authored content. Use exactly one catalog runtime.move operation, scope Instance, copied selected reference and stamp. The creator measured the live desired absolute world position as [11.5,0.0,-13.0] and yaw in degrees as 270. Copy selection mode Play. No ordinary authored move, prefab edits, assets, generation, dialogue or other operations. Do not claim a committed operation ID; the creator will apply the unchanged candidate and observe the real receipt.'
cs={'id':'cs_01M4AE2DYAEFE50NA8FP6XGAJ8','schema':'gamecore.studio.changeset/1','intent':{'text':intent,'origin':'agent'},'selection':s,'baseVersions':[{'ref':r,'stamp':r['stamp']}],'operations':[{'opId':'op1','tool':'runtime.move','target':r,'args':{'position':[11.5,0.0,-13.0],'yaw':270.0},'dependsOn':[],'preconditions':'stamp','applyRequirement':'Live'}],'artifacts':[],'requirements':{'max':'Live','worldRebuild':False,'compile':False,'build':False}}
p=pathlib.Path('/outputs/changeset.json');p.write_text(json.dumps(cs,indent=2)+'\n');check=json.loads(p.read_text());assert check['selection']==s and len(check['operations'])==1 and check['operations'][0]['target']==r and not check['artifacts'];print('verified',p,p.stat().st_size)
PY
